headnotes.la: …vel vitium jactantiae, vel amor aeternae vitae ducit plerosque. Unde beatus Augustinus cum de charitate loqueretur *quae non agit perperam [n: (I Cor. XIII)]*, quae hujus geminae intentionis judex est
headnotes.en: … to apply themselves to the word of preaching. Whence blessed Augustine, when he was speaking of charity *which dealeth not perversely [n: (I Cor. XIII)]*, which is the judge of this twofold intention

headnotes.la: Sancta ergo anima dona in se divinae gratiae sentiens debet ea suscipere et servare cum laetitia et exsultatione, et quod sentit mente opere exercere: quia enim
headnotes.en: The holy soul, then, perceiving in herself the gifts of divine grace, ought to receive and keep them with gladness and exultation, and to exercise in work what she perceives in mind: for because

headnotes.la: …in Evangelio, ut *qui reliquerit domum, aut patrem, aut matrem, aut filios, aut agros propter nomen meum centuplum accipiet [n: (Matth. XIX)]*, non quod ipsas res quas reliquit centuplicatas accipiat,
headnotes.en: … house, or father, or mother, or children, or lands for my name's sake shall receive a hundredfold [n: (Matth. XIX)]*: not that he shall receive the very things which he left multiplied a hundredfold,

headnotes.la: …t custodienda vitae munimentum, altera custoditae ornamentum: fortitudine enim spiritus opus est ad ipsam integritatem vitae custodiendam, pulchritudine ad ipsam integritatem bonis operibus exornandam
headnotes.en: …on of life that is to be guarded, the other the ornament of it when guarded: for fortitude of spirit is needed to guard that very integrity of life, beauty to adorn that very integrity with good works

headnotes.la: …ris, si circa mundi strepitum *254* versatur animus omnipotens Pater sereno pietatis intuitu, de deserto ascendentem animam miratur dicens: *Quae ista quae ascendit de deserto? Quae est ista?* inquit,
headnotes.en: …the din *254* of the world the almighty Father with a serene gaze of loving-kindness wonders at the soul going up from the desert, saying: *Who she that goeth up from the desert? Who is she?* he says,

proseNotes.raw: (cum veste nuptiali venire, ne si ista careamus, in tenebras exteriores (Matth. XXII) )
